purpose://root.note: Top-level normative requirement governing HAVEN choices.

purpose://contact.communication.note: Umbrella branch for contact and communication capabilities.

purpose://quality.note: Umbrella branch for cross-cutting quality purposes.

purpose://questionnaire.access.audit.note: Requires consent-bounded response access and minimal invitation payloads.

purpose://self-determination.data.durati.note: Requires bounded duration, withdrawal, deletion, and downstream effect.

purpose://self-determination.data.exerci.note: Requires controls to remain practically usable without unequal burdens.
